description: One receiving school's saved report card groups: its peer sets (competitors, conference, programs) and its feeders, each with who saved it and when and its members in order (unitid, name, source - ai, fallback, evidence or added - and the reasons it is there), and its report card shares still open. With propose_feeders true, also the feeders CourseShelf's evidence proposes from the publish this host serves: schools with an agreement of a counted kind (articulation, transfer, accelerated-plan, dual-admission) naming both, schools whose courses the receiving school's published rules take, and open public 2-year colleges within 50 miles; ranked by counted agreements, then course rules, then distance; at most 10, each marked proposed with its reasons. Agreements of other kinds are listed apart as other ties and never counted. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused. Nothing is saved by this read.

propose_feeders.description: Optional: also propose feeders from the publish's evidence
